name: Crescent
source:
This is four mini games in one.
One is a detective saving some friends. One is a prince trying to defeat a witch. One is a bright young scientist that drank an invisibility potion having fun in an all-girl school. And one is where a lost guy bump into an inn with some easy females.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160404053637/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-a.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
本作由四个小游戏组成。

第一个故事中，侦探要营救几名朋友；第二个故事中，王子试图打败女巫；第三个故事中，聪明的年轻科学家喝下隐形药水，在女子学校里尽情胡闹；第四个故事则讲述一名迷路男子偶然闯进旅店，遇见几个作风放荡的女人。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160404053637/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-a.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
